Blue Marble Farm is a small produce farm located in the hills of Genesee, PA. Owners Jeff and Lisa started the farm in 2005 with the premise that they could do more for their health, the health of the earth and the health of their community. With the advent of Big Agriculture and the growing dependence on processed food, many Americans have lost touch with the local farmer. Blue Marble Farm's vision is to use and protect the resources on their land and share the bounty of the harvest with their community through their CSA.
